verdict.rationale: Docs show the underlying pieces of a full payroll cycle — retrieving upcoming/unprocessed payrolls (docs-40/46), pre-generated scheduled payrolls (docs-62), off-cycle and regular payroll processing with tax/bank handling (docs-44, docs-52, docs-58), and a contractor payment preview/submission-blockers flow (docs-27, docs-10) — implying a review→preview→submit path exists via the platform's API/guides (e.g. 'complete-a-regular-payroll' guide). However, there is no explicit documentation of an 'hours and earnings' review step for employee payroll or a single unified UI flow that ties review, preview totals, and submit together, and the newer companion CLI explicitly 'only drafts payroll — it has no run/submit command, so it can't move money' (gusto-contest-61-1), underscoring that submission isn't exposed as a one-flow action in every surface. missing for 10: explicit employee hours/earnings review step, a documented single end-to-end review-preview-submit UI/API flow, and independent hands-on confirmation of the full cycle working seamlessly.
